name: Baseline Control
hypothesis: 1m EMA9/21 crossover + RSI 50 threshold without additional filters.

name: Candidate 1: Chop-Filtered Trend Follower
hypothesis: 1m EMA crossovers fail primarily due to whipsaw in chop and counter-trend entries. Excluding crossovers with >= 2 crosses in 20 bars and enforcing intermediate trend alignment (Close > EMA50) removes negative expectancy noise.

name: Candidate 2: Pullback Entry with Tighter Target
hypothesis: Immediate market entry at crossover suffers from late fill and high MAE. Waiting for a pullback to EMA21 with an evidence-based tighter target (1.25 ATR stop / 1.5 ATR target) increases win rate and captures positive initial MFE.

name: Candidate 3: Time-Windowed Momentum Breakout
hypothesis: Mid-day trading (11:15-13:30) experiences severe false breaks and flat expectancy. Restricting entries to active market sessions (09:30-11:15 & 13:30-15:00) with momentum bar confirmation eliminates low-volume chop trades.
